description:
FAR 12.202(b)(1)(i) “This is a solicitation for Commercial services prepared in accordance with part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Offers are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued”.

Solicitation number N0040626Q0044 is issued as a request for quotation (RFQ) for a mini RUBB building roof repair service at NBK Bremerton, WA with an opportunity to attend a site visit on 7 April 2026 with details in attached solicitation.

This acquisition is set-aside for small business concerns. This solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at www.acquisition.gov.
